subject: probe350mcu2 result: firmware ran this boot, servicing not shown; ping GO, DVFS NO-GO
body:
probe350mcu2 (c6r) interpreted: README-0107-design.md section 12. No device ops.
ALIVE? Firmware RAN this boot (strong): the window 0x10301000+47 KiB is 156 ZERO blocks + 28 STRUCT blocks, 0 noise blocks, and the zero/structured cells did NOT decay between probe boots while the noise cells flipped 5-10 % per mailbox, so those cells were rewritten this boot (bss clear + init of 7 records of 2 KiB; mbox3 TASK_STA=INIT). SERVICING doorbells: NOT shown: 0 of 200 mailbox words and 0 of 11776 window words changed in 120 s, control regs 0 in all samples, TASK_STA constant, CPU clocks unchanged. Idle-in-WFI and halted look identical.
POINTERS: none (0 words in 0x7e900000+1MiB, 0 page-aligned DRAM words, no strings).
CODE: not in the window (it is the firmware's RAM: bss + 7 per-instance records, probably per-CPU idle data). Ranked: gap 0x1030c800..0x1031fce0 (probe350mcu3 reads it), private TCM/ROM invisible to the AP, DRAM mblock 0x7e900000 (not probed).
GO/NO-GO: Step 2 ping = GO (needs its own approval and an image I have not built; confined to 3 words of mbox0 send half + doorbell bit 0 of 0x10300154, once, abort rules and outcome table A-D in 12.6). Full DVFS bring-up = NO-GO today (liveness unproven, cmd 0/10/1 payloads and CSRAM table copy not validated, init is irreversible until reboot). Correction: the mailbox-3 handshake (modes, PWR_CTRL, AP_READY) belongs to cpuidle init, not DVFS; the DVFS bring-up never writes mailbox 3 or AP_READY. Safe sequence: ping -> (only if A) PLT_INIT with a 2 MiB wired buffer we allocate -> host-only decode of cmd payloads (can start now) -> DVFS init without frequency change -> first single-row steps.
